item.title: FinTech Regulations for Architects
item.description:
Simple definition#

FinTech regulations set legally binding requirements for how financial services protect money, data and customers, and how they stay operational. For architects, every regulation turns into non-functional requirements: security controls, data handling, resilience, auditability and reporting timelines.

item.title: System Design: A Secure, Compliant Payments Platform
item.description:
The design brief#

“A digital bank operating in the EU and India is launching card and account-to-account payments, an open-banking API for partners, and a GenAI assistant that answers customer questions and can initiate small transfers. Design the security architecture so that it is PCI DSS, DORA, PSD2/PSD3, GDPR/DPDP and RBI compliant, and can withstand a determined attacker.”
